name: UniProt
summary: The UniProt protein sequence and function knowledgebase (UniProtKB, UniRef, UniParc): query search, entry retrieval and identifier mapping.
notes: Keyless. Ask for format=json; without it or an Accept header some endpoints answer another format.
Search pages with a cursor: the next page's full URL is in the Link response header (rel="next"), the total in x-total-results. Use size=500 for speed.
Query syntax is UniProt's own, e.g. (reviewed:true) AND (organism_id:9606) or gene:BRCA1.

endpoints.name: Search a UniProt dataset
endpoints.summary: One page of entries matching a query, from UniProtKB or another dataset.

dataset.description: Dataset: uniprotkb, uniref, uniparc, taxonomy, etc.

query.description: UniProt query; empty matches every entry.

format.description: json, tsv, fasta, xml, txt, list, gff, obo, rdf or xlsx (not every dataset offers every format).

fields.description: Comma-separated return columns (tsv, xlsx and json only), e.g. accession,gene_names,organism_name.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's Link header.

endpoints.name: Stream all matching entries
endpoints.summary: Every entry matching a query in one response, without paging.

dataset.description: Dataset: uniprotkb, uniref, uniparc, taxonomy, etc.

format.description: json, tsv, fasta, xml, txt, list, gff, obo, rdf or xlsx (not every dataset offers every format).

fields.description: Comma-separated return columns (tsv, xlsx and json only), e.g. accession,gene_names,organism_name.

notes: Expensive: parallel stream calls get 429; at most 10,000,000 entries. Prefer entries.search pages for large sets.

endpoints.name: Get one entry
endpoints.summary: A single UniProtKB, UniRef or UniParc entry by its identifier.

dataset.description: Dataset: uniprotkb, uniref, uniparc, taxonomy, etc.

id.description: Accession or cluster id, e.g. P12345, UniRef90_P99999, UPI000000001F.

format.description: json, tsv, fasta, xml, txt, list, gff, obo, rdf or xlsx (not every dataset offers every format).

fields.description: Comma-separated return columns (tsv, xlsx and json only), e.g. accession,gene_names,organism_name.

notes: UniRef ids are not stable across releases. A removed entry answers 410.

endpoints.name: Start an ID mapping job
endpoints.summary: Submit identifiers to map from one database to another (e.g. UniProtKB_AC-ID to Ensembl).

from_db.description: Source database name, as /configure/idmapping/fields lists it.

taxId.description: Taxonomy id, for the database pairs that accept one.

notes: A read over POST: it starts a mapping job and returns a jobId. Poll idmapping.status, then fetch idmapping.results.

endpoints.name: Check an ID mapping job
endpoints.summary: jobStatus of a mapping job (FINISHED when ready).
notes: A finished job answers 303 with the results URL in the Location header.

endpoints.name: Get ID mapping results
endpoints.summary: One page of from/to pairs of a finished mapping job.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's Link header.

format.description: json, tsv, fasta, xml, txt, list, gff, obo, rdf or xlsx (not every dataset offers every format).

notes: Mapped to UniProtKB, UniRef or UniParc, the full entries are at /idmapping/{uniprotkb|uniref|uniparc}/results/{jobId}; /idmapping/stream/{jobId} returns all at once.

endpoints.name: List mappable databases
endpoints.summary: Every database pair the ID mapping service accepts, with the rules for valid from/to combinations.
